title: Advanced Clinical Practice
subject: Nursing & Health
summary: For experienced health professionals moving into advanced, autonomous clinical roles.
description: Designed for registered nurses and allied health professionals, this master's develops advanced assessment, diagnosis and decision-making skills.
It is usually studied part-time alongside work, with support from your employer.
entryRequirements: Registration with a UK professional body (e.g. NMC or HCPC)
A bachelor's degree and relevant clinical experience
Support from your employer for clinical practice
